name: figma-code-workflows
description: Import or upload local HTML or project files into Figma, import a GitHub repository into Figma or pull its updates into linked Figma code, choose editable Design frames, runnable Code Layers or standalone Code (also known as Make), and repair imported previews. Use only when the user explicitly names editable Design layers, a runnable Code Layer, or a standalone Code/Make file, or supplies a Figma file key/link as the import destination. A request that does not say where in Figma the code should go, such as turning a local folder into a code project or writing a code component, needs output clarification before using this workflow.
